items.quote: Our guests were blown away by the envelope animation! It's the detail that changed everything. The RSVP feature saved us so much time.
The atmosphere was magical, with twinkling lights and enchanting music. Every moment was captured.

FAQ.q1: Can I edit my site after sending invitations?
FAQ.a1: Absolutely! That's the magic of digital. You can change times, add accommodation info, or change a photo at any time. Your guests will always see the up-to-date version.
FAQ.q2: Do I have to pay a monthly subscription?
FAQ.a2: No, never. It is a one-time payment. Your site stays online for 12 months after your wedding, giving you time to share memory photos.
FAQ.q3: How do guests confirm their attendance (RSVP)?
FAQ.a3: A simple and elegant form is integrated into your site. You receive responses instantly in your dashboard (and via email if you wish). You can export the guest list in one click.
FAQ.q4: Can I have a custom domain name?
FAQ.a4: Yes! With the 'Custom Domain' option (+65€) or included in the Premium pack, you can have an address like www.paula-and-marcos.com.
FAQ.q5: Do you offer matching paper invitations?
FAQ.a5: We focus on the digital experience for now, but we can provide high-definition PDF files of your design so you can print them at your local printer.

sections.heading: 2. Services offered
paragraphs: The Studio Digital Papeterie offers a service for creating customizable digital wedding invitations (the "Service"), including access to an online configurator, the generation of a dedicated invitation website, and, depending on the plan chosen, a post-purchase management area (dashboard) allowing the Customer to track guest responses (RSVP).

sections.heading: 3. Price and payment
paragraphs: The prices of the Services are shown in euros, all taxes included, at the time of the order. The Studio Digital Papeterie reserves the right to modify its prices at any time, it being understood that the price shown on the site on the day of the order is the only one applicable to the Customer.

Payment is made online, at the time of the order, by credit card through our secure payment provider Stripe. The Studio Digital Papeterie does not store any banking data; this is processed directly by Stripe in accordance with the PCI-DSS standard.
The order is only considered final once payment has been confirmed by Stripe and a confirmation email has been sent to the Customer.

sections.heading: 4. Right of withdrawal
paragraphs: In accordance with applicable consumer law, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for contracts for the supply of digital content not provided on a physical medium, the performance of which has begun after the consumer's prior express agreement and express waiver of their right of withdrawal.

By confirming their order and immediately accessing the configurator or their invitation website, the Customer expressly acknowledges requesting the immediate performance of the Service and waiving their right of withdrawal.

sections.heading: 5. Duration and termination
paragraphs: Access to the invitation website and, where applicable, to the dashboard is provided for the duration specified in the offer purchased by the Customer at the time of purchase. At the end of this period, access may be suspended or the offer renewed according to the terms communicated to the Customer before expiry.

sections.heading: 6. Liability

The Studio Digital Papeterie cannot be held liable for the content (text, images, information) provided by the Customer as part of the customization of their invitation or invitation website.

The Customer benefits from a right of use limited to the creation of their personal invitation and invitation website, excluding any commercial use or resale.

sections.heading: 8. Personal data

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller responsible for processing personal data collected on this site is [Company name to complete], with registered office at [address to complete], reachable at [contact email to complete] (hereinafter "The Studio Digital Papeterie").

sections.heading: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: As part of the use of the Service, we collect in particular: the Customer's identification and contact details (first name, last name, email address); information relating to the wedding and guests entered in the configurator and dashboard (guest names, households, tables, RSVP responses, dietary requirements, messages); payment data, processed exclusively by our provider Stripe; technical browsing data (cookies, IP address, connection logs).

sections.heading: 3. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: This data is collected in order to: provide and customize the Service (creation of the invitation and invitation website); manage the contractual relationship and payment of the order; enable the collection and management of guest responses (RSVP) on behalf of the Customer; provide customer support; comply with our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: Processing is based, depending on the case, on the performance of the contract concluded with the Customer, on consent (in particular for non-essential cookies), or on compliance with a legal obligation.

sections.heading: 5. Hosting and subcontractors
paragraphs: Data is hosted by Supabase (database and authentication) and payments are processed by Stripe. These providers may process data outside the European Union, subject to appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses or equivalent).
Site host: [hosting provider to complete].

sections.heading: 6. Retention period
paragraphs: Data is retained for the period necessary to provide the Service, plus the legal retention periods applicable in commercial and accounting matters, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: 7. Data sharing
paragraphs: Guest data entered by the Customer (particularly RSVP responses) is visible to the Customer in their dashboard. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes. It may be shared with our technical subcontractors (hosting, payment) strictly to the extent necessary for the performance of the Service.

sections.heading: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation as well as, where applicable, audience measurement cookies subject to visitor consent, manageable via the cookie management banner present on the site.

sections.heading: 9. Data subject rights
paragraphs: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), everyone has the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port their data, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority (in France, the CNIL, www.cnil.fr).
These rights may be exercised by writing to [contact email to complete].

sections.heading: 10. Security
paragraphs: The Studio Digital Papeterie implements reasonable technical and organizational measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of personal data, in particular through encryption of data in transit and restricted access policies (RLS) on the database.
